message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas – Quick Reference Guide** | Topic | Key Points | Where to Find More Info | |-------|------------|------------------------| | **Speed Limits** | • Posted limits apply unless otherwise indicated.
• 55 mph on rural interstates, 65 mph on urban interstates, 45 mph on most highways.
• School zones: 25 mph (or 20 mph if posted). | Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT) – Speed Limit Regulations | | **Seat‑belt & Child Safety** | • All drivers and passengers must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child safety seat or booster. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Cell‑Phone Use** | • Hand‑held phone use while driving is prohibited.
• Hands‑free devices are allowed. | TxDOT – “Hands‑Free” Law | | **DUI / Alcohol** | • Blood alcohol concentration (BAC) of 0.08% or higher is illegal.
• Zero‑tolerance for drivers under 21.
• Penalties include fines, license suspension, and possible jail time. | Texas Alcoholic Beverage Commission (TABC) – DUI Enforcement | | **Driving Under Influence of Drugs** | • Prescription drugs that impair driving are treated like alcohol.
• Penalties similar to DUI. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Traffic Signals & Signs** | • Red light = stop; green = go; yellow = caution.
• Stop signs require a full stop.
• Yield signs give right‑of‑way to the vehicle already in the intersection. | TxDOT – Traffic Signal & Sign Standards | | **Right‑of‑Way Rules** | • At uncontrolled intersections, the driver on the right has priority.
• Pedestrians always have right‑of‑way at crosswalks. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Lane Discipline** | • Keep to the right lane unless passing.
• Use turn lanes when turning. | TxDOT – Lane Use Guidelines | | **School Bus** | • Vehicles must stop when a school bus is loading/unloading children.
• Must remain stopped until the bus resumes motion. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Parking Regulations** | • No parking within 20 ft of a crosswalk, fire hydrant, or intersection.
• No parking on sidewalks unless marked. | TxDOT – Parking Rules | | **Vehicle Registration & Inspection** | • All vehicles must be registered and display a valid license plate.
• Most vehicles must pass an annual safety inspection. | Texas Department of Motor Vehicles (TxDMV) | | **Insurance Requirements** | • Minimum liability coverage: $30,000 for bodily injury per person, $60,000 for total bodily injury, $25,000 for property damage. | TxDMV – Insurance Requirements | | **Special Vehicle Rules** | • Motorcycles: helmet required for riders under 18.
• Commercial vehicles: additional licensing and safety regulations. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Emergency Vehicles** | • Drivers must yield to emergency vehicles with flashing lights or sirens. | TxDOT – Emergency Vehicle Protocols | | **Penalties for Violations** | • Fines vary by offense; repeat offenders face higher penalties.
• Points added to driving record can lead to license suspension. | TxDMV – Penalty Schedule | ### How to Stay Updated - **TxDOT Website** – Official rules, updates, and public notices. - **TxDMV** – Licensing, registration, and insurance requirements. - **Texas Transportation Code** – Full legal text (available online). - **Local County Courts** – For specific local ordinances or recent changes. --- #### Quick Tips for Safe Driving in Texas 1. **Always obey posted speed limits** – they’re set for safety. 2. **Keep your seat belt fastened** – it’s a legal requirement and saves lives. 3. **Avoid handheld phone use** – use hands‑free or pull over if you need to talk. 4. **Check for school bus signals** – stop and wait until the bus moves. 5. **Stay alert for pedestrians** – especially in school zones and crosswalks. 6. **Keep your vehicle in good condition** – regular inspections prevent accidents. Feel free to ask if you need details on a specific law or how to handle a particular situation!
